en.s: The Battle of Actium was a naval battle fought between Octavian's maritime fleet, led by Marcus Agrippa, and the combined fleets of Mark Antony and Cleopatra. The battle took place on 2 September 31 BC in the Ionian Sea, near the former Roman colony of Actium, Greece, and was the climax of over a decade of rivalry between Octavian and Mark Antony.

zh.s: 亚克兴海战是屋大维一方的舰队与马克·安东尼和克娄巴特拉联军舰队之间的一场海战。屋大维的舰队由马库斯·阿格里帕指挥。战斗于公元前31年9月2日在爱奥尼亚海、希腊旧殖民地亚克兴附近爆发，是屋大维与马克·安东尼十多年争斗的高潮。

en.s: In 1125–1126, the Arago-Navarrese king Alfonso the Battler launched a military expedition to capture the city of Granada from the Almoravids. The campaign was carried out over nine months (between September 2, 1125, and June 1126) during which he camped for a long time near Granada, he plundered fields and riches, he defeated the Almoravid army in a pitched battle in Arnisol Anzur, near Puente Genil, south of the current province of Córdoba and rescued a contingent of Mozarabs with which he repopulated the lands of the Ebro Valley recently conquered by the kingdom of Aragon.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1125至1126年，阿拉贡—纳瓦拉国王阿方索一世发动远征，试图从穆拉比特王朝手中夺取格拉纳达。这场战役持续九个月，从1125年9月2日到1126年6月。阿方索曾长期驻扎在格拉纳达附近，掠夺田地和财物，并在科尔多瓦现辖区以南、蓬特赫尼尔附近的阿尔尼斯奥尔·安苏尔与穆拉比特军队进行会战并将其击败。他还救出一批莫扎拉布人，并将他们迁往阿拉贡王国新近征服的埃布罗河谷地区。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Treaty of Jaffa, less commonly referred to as the Treaty of Ramla or the treaty of 1192, was a truce agreed to during the Crusades. It was signed on 1 or 2 September 1192 A.D. (20th of Sha'ban 588 AH) between Saladin, Sultan of Egypt and Richard the Lionheart, King of England, shortly after the July–August 1192 Battle of Jaffa.

zh.s: 雅法条约也称拉姆拉条约或1192年条约，是十字军东征期间达成的一项停战协议。它于公元1192年9月1日或2日（伊斯兰历舍尔邦月20日）由埃及苏丹萨拉丁与英格兰国王理查一世签署，当时距1192年7月至8月的雅法之战不久。

en.s: The Battle of Albulena, also known as the Battle of Ujëbardha, was fought on 2 September 1457 between Albanian forces led by Skanderbeg and an Ottoman army under Isak bey Evrenoz and Skanderbeg's nephew, Hamza Kastrioti. Skanderbeg had been the leader of the Albanians for over a decade and had seen many victories over Ottoman arms. However, after his loss at Berat in 1455 at the hands of Isak bey, Skanderbeg was betrayed by some of his most trusted officers, among them Moisi Arianit Golemi. Golemi returned the next year with an Ottoman force under his command, but was defeated at the Battle of Oranik and rejoined Skanderbeg's army.

zh.s: 阿尔布莱纳战役又称乌耶巴尔达战役，于1457年9月2日打响，交战双方是斯坎德培率领的阿尔巴尼亚军队和由伊萨克贝伊·埃夫雷诺兹及斯坎德培的侄子哈姆扎·卡斯特里奥蒂率领的奥斯曼军队。斯坎德培领导阿尔巴尼亚人已有十多年，曾多次战胜奥斯曼军队。1455年，他在贝拉特败给伊萨克贝伊后，受到几名最信任的军官背叛，其中包括莫伊西·阿里亚尼特·戈莱米。次年，戈莱米率领一支奥斯曼军队返回，但在奥拉尼克战役中被击败，随后重新加入斯坎德培的军队。

en.s: The Battle of Moclín or Disaster of Moclín was a military engagement during the Granada War. Ferdinand II of Aragon dispatched a force under the Count of Cabra to capture the city of Moclin. The Granadan forces under Muhammad XII of Granada were victorious and repelled the Castilian attack.

zh.s: 莫克林战役又称莫克林灾难，是格拉纳达战争期间的一场战斗。阿拉贡国王费尔南多二世派遣卡夫拉伯爵率军攻占莫克林城。格拉纳达十二世穆罕默德率领的格拉纳达军队获胜，击退了卡斯蒂利亚军队的进攻。

en.s: In 1506, the 12th year of Yeonsangun, a group of officials – notably Pak Wŏnjong, Sŏng Hŭian, Yu Sunjŏng and Hong Kyŏngju plotted against the despotic ruler. They launched a coup on September 2, 1506, deposing the king and replacing him with his half-brother, Grand Prince Jinseong. The king was demoted to prince, and exiled to Ganghwa Island, where he died a few weeks later.

zh.s: 燕山君在位第12年（1506年），朴元宗、成希颜、柳顺汀和洪景舟等官员密谋推翻这位专制君主。1506年9月2日，他们发动政变，废黜燕山君，改立其同父异母弟晋城大君为王。燕山君被降为君，流放到江华岛，数周后去世。

en.t: Entry of Mary, Queen of Scots into Edinburgh, a spectacular civic celebration for the Queen of Scotland, marred by religious controversy
en.s: On 19 August 1561, the 18-year-old Mary, Queen of Scots, returned to Scotland from France following the death of her husband Francis II of France the previous winter. On 2 September the town of Edinburgh organised a celebration of royal entry for her.

zh.t: 苏格兰女王玛丽入城爱丁堡庆典
zh.s: 1561年8月19日，18岁的苏格兰女王玛丽在丈夫、法国国王弗朗索瓦二世于前一年冬天去世后，从法国返回苏格兰。9月2日，爱丁堡为她举行了盛大的入城庆典。

en.s: The Siege of Gyula was a prolonged Ottoman siege of the Hungarian fortress of Gyula in 1566, part of Suleiman I's last campaign. The fortress was an important Habsburg defensive stronghold in eastern Hungary and represented a key point in the frontier system between Habsburg and Ottoman territories. Gyula was situated within the Ottoman network of fortresses at Temesvár, Szeged and Szolnok, and controlled access to the Körös valley route, making it the campaign's second major target after Szigetvár.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 久洛围城战是1566年奥斯曼帝国对匈牙利久洛要塞进行的一场长期围攻，属于苏莱曼一世最后一次军事行动。该要塞是匈牙利东部重要的哈布斯堡防御据点，也是哈布斯堡与奥斯曼边境防御体系中的要地。久洛位于奥斯曼帝国蒂米什瓦拉、塞格德和索尔诺克等要塞组成的防线内，控制着通往克勒什河谷的道路，是这次战役中继西盖特堡之后的第二个主要目标。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The siege of Coevorden was a siege that took place between 26 July and 2 September 1592 during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo–Spanish War at the city of Coevorden by a Dutch and English force under overall command of Maurice of Nassau. The city was defended by Frederik van den Bergh who had been commissioned for the defence by King Philip II of Spain.

zh.s: 1592年7月26日至9月2日，八十年战争和英西战争期间，拿骚的莫里斯统率荷兰和英国联军围攻科福尔登城。守军由弗雷德里克·范登贝赫指挥，他受西班牙国王腓力二世委派负责城防。

en.s: The siege of Jülich of 1610 took place from 28 July to 2 September 1610, during the opening stages of the War of the Jülich Succession. After an Imperial force occupied the city of Jülich, a Franco, Dutch, Palatine, and Brandenburg army besieged the city, compelling the Imperials to surrender and withdraw.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1610年于利希围城战发生于7月28日至9月2日，是于利希继承战争初期的一场战事。帝国军队占领于利希后，法国、荷兰、普法尔茨和勃兰登堡联军围城，迫使帝国军投降撤离。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Lostwithiel took place over a 13-day period from 21 August to 2 September 1644, around the town of Lostwithiel and along the River Fowey valley in Cornwall during the First English Civil War. A Royalist army led by Charles I of England defeated a Parliamentarian force commanded by the Earl of Essex. Although Essex and most of the cavalry escaped, between 5,000 and 6,000 Parliamentarian infantry were forced to surrender.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第一次英国内战期间，洛斯特威西尔战役于1644年8月21日至9月2日进行，战场在康沃尔郡洛斯特威西尔镇及福伊河谷一带。查理一世率领的保王党军队击败了由埃塞克斯伯爵指挥的议会军。埃塞克斯和大部分骑兵成功脱身，但5,000至6,000名议会军步兵被迫投降。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: The Great Fire of London breaks out and burns for three days, destroying 10,000 buildings, including Old St Paul's Cathedral
en.s: The Great Fire of London occurred from Sunday 2 September to Wednesday 5 September 1666, gutting the medieval City of London inside the old Roman city wall, while also extending past the wall to the west. The death toll is generally thought to have been relatively small, although some historians have challenged this belief. The fire started in a bakery in Pudding Lane shortly after midnight on Sunday 2 September and spread rapidly.

zh.s: 伦敦大火从1666年9月2日（星期日）持续到9月5日（星期三），烧毁了古罗马城墙内的中世纪伦敦城，并蔓延到城墙以西。一般认为死亡人数相对较少，但一些历史学家对此提出质疑。大火于9月2日午夜刚过时从布丁巷一家面包店燃起，并迅速蔓延。

en.s: The siege of Kamenets was a military engagement by the Polish to seize the Ottoman fortress of Kamenets. The siege ended in failure.

zh.s: 波兰军队围攻奥斯曼帝国的卡缅涅茨要塞，试图将其攻下，但围城以失败告终。

en.s: In the Battle of Lake Huleh on 2 September 1771, the rebel forces of Daher al-Umar and Nasif al-Nassar routed the army of Uthman Pasha al-Kurji, the Ottoman governor of Damascus, at Lake Huleh in the eastern Galilee. Most of Uthman Pasha's 10,000-40,000 strong army drowned in the Jordan River as they attempted to flee Daher's forces commanded by his son Ali al-Daher.

zh.s: 1771年9月2日，达希尔·欧麦尔和纳西夫·纳萨尔率领的起义军在加利利东部的胡勒湖击溃了奥斯曼帝国大马士革总督乌斯曼帕夏·库尔吉的军队。乌斯曼帕夏军队有1万至4万人，其中大多数人在逃离由达希尔之子阿里·达希尔指挥的部队时，淹死在约旦河中。

en.s: The action of 2 September 1781 was a minor naval engagement fought off Cape Ann during the American War of Independence; HMS Chatham captured the French frigate Magicienne after a fight of a few hours. On 2 September, the British fifty gun fourth-rate Chatham under Captain Andrew Snape Douglas was cruising off Cape Ann near Boston harbour and spotted the French frigate Magicienne, escorting a merchantman.

zh.s: 美国独立战争期间，1781年9月2日安角附近发生了一场小规模海战。英国皇家海军“查塔姆”号与法国护卫舰“魔女”号交战数小时后，将其俘获。“查塔姆”号是有50门炮的英国四级战列舰，由安德鲁·斯内普·道格拉斯舰长指挥。当日，该舰在波士顿港附近的安角外海巡航时，发现了正在护送一艘商船的“魔女”号。

en.t: U.S. Congress establishes the Department of the Treasury
en.s: On September 2, 1789, an act of Congress established the United States Department of the Treasury. The law created a secretary and other officers to oversee the young federal government's finances, accounts and public debt. Alexander Hamilton was nominated as the first treasury secretary later that month.
en.n: Congress established the department by law on September 2, 1789; Hamilton's nomination followed on September 11.

zh.s: 1789年9月2日，美国国会通过法案，设立联邦财政部。法律设置财政部长及其他官员，负责管理新联邦政府的财政、账目和公共债务。亚历山大·汉密尔顿于当月稍后被提名为首任财政部长。
zh.n: 财政部于1789年9月2日依法设立；汉密尔顿的提名是在9月11日。

en.s: The Battle of Verdun was fought between 29 August and 2 September 1792 between French Revolutionary forces and a Prussian army during the opening months of the War of the First Coalition. The Prussians were victorious, gaining a clear westward path to Paris.

zh.s: 第一次反法同盟战争开始后的头几个月，法国革命军与普鲁士军队于1792年8月29日至9月2日在凡尔登交战。普鲁士获胜，向西进军巴黎的道路因此畅通。

en.s: The September Massacres were a series of killings and summary executions of prisoners in Paris that occurred in 1792 from 2 September to 6 September during the French Revolution. Between 1,176 and 1,614 people were killed by sans-culottes, fédérés, and guardsmen, with the support of gendarmes responsible for guarding the tribunals and prisons, the Cordeliers, the Committee of Surveillance of the Commune, and the revolutionary sections of Paris.

zh.s: 法国大革命期间，巴黎于1792年9月2日至6日发生一系列杀戮和对囚犯的即决处决，史称九月屠杀。无套裤汉、联邦派成员和卫兵在宪兵、科德利埃俱乐部、巴黎公社监察委员会及巴黎各革命区的支持下，杀害了1,176至1,614人。

en.s: The siege of Malta, also known as the siege of Valletta or the French blockade (Maltese: L-Imblokk tal-Franċiżi), was a two-year siege and blockade of the French garrison in Valletta and the Three Cities, the largest settlements and main port on the Mediterranean island of Malta, between 1798 and 1800. Malta had been captured by a French expeditionary force during the Mediterranean campaign of 1798, and garrisoned with 3,000 soldiers under the command of Claude-Henri Belgrand de Vaubois.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 马耳他围城战也称瓦莱塔围城战或法国封锁（马耳他语：L-Imblokk tal-Franċiżi），是1798至1800年间对瓦莱塔和三城地区法国驻军持续两年的围城与封锁。瓦莱塔和三城是地中海岛国马耳他最大的居民区和主要港口。马耳他于1798年地中海战役期间被法国远征军占领，法国随后派3,000名士兵驻守，由克洛德-亨利·贝尔格朗·德·沃布瓦指挥。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The siege of Alexandria (17 August – 2 September 1801) was fought during the French Revolutionary Wars between French and British forces. It was the last action of the French invasion of Egypt and Syria (1798–1801). The French had occupied Alexandria, a major fortified harbour city on the Nile Delta in northern Egypt, since 2 July 1798, and the garrison there surrendered on 2 September 1801.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 亚历山大港围城战发生于1801年8月17日至9月2日，是法国大革命战争期间法国与英国军队之间的战事，也是法国入侵埃及和叙利亚（1798—1801年）的最后一场战斗。法国自1798年7月2日起占领亚历山大港。1801年9月2日，城内守军投降。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Anglo-Russian War (2 September 1807 – 18 July 1812) was fought between the United Kingdom and the Russian Empire during the Napoleonic Wars. It began after Russia signed the Treaty of Tilsit with the First French Empire, which ended hostilities between the two nations. During the war, actual military engagements were limited primarily to minor naval actions in the Baltic Sea and Barents Sea.

zh.s: 英俄战争发生于拿破仑战争期间，交战双方是英国和俄罗斯帝国，时间为1807年9月2日至1812年7月18日。俄罗斯与法兰西第一帝国签署《提尔西特条约》、结束两国敌对状态后，英俄战争随之爆发。战争期间的实际交战主要是波罗的海和巴伦支海的小规模海战。

en.s: The battle of Ruona–Salmi or the battle of Kuortane was fought between Swedish and Russian troops on 1–2 September 1808 at Ruona and Salmi, Kuortane. The Swedish army was led by Wilhelm Mauritz Klingspor with 4,700, 5,000, or 5,500 men under his command (according to Russian sources, there were 8,000 Swedes or 7,000 regular soldiers and 5,000 irregular) against the Russian army of between 9,000 and 11,000 men under the command of Nikolay Kamensky.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 鲁奥纳—萨尔米战役又称库奥尔塔内战役，瑞典与俄罗斯军队于1808年9月1日至2日在库奥尔塔内的鲁奥纳和萨尔米交战。瑞典军由威廉·毛里茨·克林斯波尔指挥，兵力为4,700、5,000或5,500人；按俄罗斯方面的说法，瑞典军有8,000人，或由7,000名正规军和5,000名非正规军组成。尼古拉·卡缅斯基指挥的俄军有9,000至11,000人。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Raid on Alexandria was a British victory during the War of 1812, which gained much plunder at little cost but may have contributed to the later British repulse at Baltimore by delaying their main forces.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 亚历山大里亚突袭（弗吉尼亚州）
zh.s: 1812年战争期间，英国军队突袭亚历山大里亚并取得胜利，几乎没有付出代价便掠得大量战利品。不过，这次行动拖慢了英军主力，可能也促成了英军后来在巴尔的摩遭到击退。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Vermont voters cast ballots in the 1834 governor election
en.s: On September 2, 1834, Vermont voters cast ballots in a three-way governor election. Incumbent William A. Palmer led the popular vote but received less than a majority. The Vermont General Assembly considered the returns in October and selected Palmer for another one-year term. His reelection was therefore a later outcome, not a decision reached on September 2.
en.n: Popular voting took place September 2; the legislature selected Palmer after the results were considered in October.

zh.t: 佛蒙特州举行1834年州长选举全民投票
zh.s: 1834年9月2日，美国佛蒙特州举行州长选举全民投票，现任州长威廉·A·帕尔默得票最多，但未过半。州议会在10月审议选票结果后，再选他连任一年。因此9月2日是选民投票日，并非议会确定连任的日期。
zh.n: 选民于9月2日投票；州议会在10月审议结果后选出帕尔默。

en.s: The 1844 Republic of Texas presidential election was the fourth and last presidential election. It was held on September 2, 1844. The contest was held between Anson Jones and Edward Burleson, the vice president of the Republic of Texas. Jones defeated Burleson by a margin of 1,376 votes to become the fourth and final President of Texas.

zh.t: 1844年德克萨斯共和国总统选举
zh.s: 1844年9月2日举行的德克萨斯共和国总统选举是该共和国第四次也是最后一次总统选举。参选者为安森·琼斯和共和国副总统爱德华·伯利森。琼斯以1,376票的优势击败伯利森，成为德克萨斯共和国第四任也是最后一任总统。

en.s: The 1845 Vermont gubernatorial election was held on September 2, 1845. Incumbent Whig Governor William Slade defeated Democratic nominee Daniel Kellogg and Liberty nominee William R. Shafter. Since no candidate received a majority in the popular vote, Slade was elected by the Vermont General Assembly per the state constitution.

en.s: The Battle of Mile Hill was a cavalry skirmish during the American Civil War, that took place just north of Leesburg, Virginia, on September 2, 1862. It preceded the occupation of the town by the Army of Northern Virginia just prior to its crossing of the Potomac River starting the Maryland Campaign. Confederate cavalry under Col. Thomas T. Munford surprised and routed the Federal force of Cole's Maryland Cavalry and the independent Loudoun Rangers. The engagement successfully cleared the area of Federal forces, allowing Robert E. Lee and the Army of Northern Virginia to occupy the town two days later on September 4, before crossing the Potomac north of town on September 6.

en.s: The Rock Springs massacre, also known as the Rock Springs Riot, occurred on September 2, 1885, in the present-day United States city of Rock Springs in Sweetwater County, Wyoming. The riot, between Chinese immigrant miners and white immigrant miners, was the result of racial tensions and an ongoing labor dispute over the Union Pacific Coal Department's policy of paying Chinese miners lower wages than white miners. This policy caused the Chinese to be hired over the white miners, which further angered the white miners and contributed to the riot. Racial tensions were an even bigger factor in the massacre.

en.s: At the Battle of Omdurman (2 September 1898), an army commanded by the British General Sir Herbert Kitchener defeated the army of Abdullah al-Taashi, the successor to the self-proclaimed Mahdi, Muhammad Ahmad. Kitchener was seeking revenge for the death of General Gordon in 1884. It was a demonstration of the superiority of a highly disciplined army equipped with modern rifles, machine guns and artillery over a force twice their size armed with older weapons, and marked the success of British efforts to re-conquer the Sudan. However, it was not until the 1899 Battle of Umm Diwaykarat that the final Mahdist forces were defeated.

en.s: The Battle of Komarów, or the Zamość Ring, was one of the most important battles of the Polish-Bolshevik War. It took place between 30 August and 2 September 1920, near the village of Komarowo (now Komarów) near Zamość. It was one of the largest cavalry battles since 1813 and the last great battle of any significance in which cavalry was used as such and not as mounted infantry. The battle ended in complete disaster for the Russian 1st Cavalry Army, which sustained heavy casualties and barely avoided being surrounded and annihilated.

en.s: The Kantō Massacre (關東大虐殺; Korean: 간토대학살) was a mass murder in the Kantō region of Japan committed in the aftermath of the 1923 Great Kantō Earthquake. With the explicit and implicit approval of parts of the Japanese government, the Japanese military, police, and vigilantes murdered an estimated 6,000 people: mainly ethnic Koreans, but also Chinese and misidentified Japanese, and Japanese communists, socialists, and anarchists.

en.t: Transnistrian delegates proclaim a Soviet republic in Tiraspol

en.s: The National Museum of Brazil was heavily damaged by a large fire which began about 19:30 local time (23:30 UTC) on 2 September 2018. Although some items were saved, it is believed that 92% of its archive of 20 million items was destroyed in the fire. The small number of unscathed items were stored in a separate building which was not damaged.
en.n: National Museum of Brazil fire: A massive fire destroys most of the Paço de São Cristóvão, which houses the National Museum of Brazil, in Rio de Janeiro. The museum holds important archaeοlogical and anthropological objects, including the remains of the Luzia Woman, Marajoara vases and Egyptian mummies.

zh.n: 巴西国家博物馆火灾：里约热内卢圣克里斯托旺宫发生大火，馆舍内的大部分建筑被毁。馆藏包括重要的考古和人类学文物，如卢齐亚女性遗骸、马拉若拉陶罐和埃及木乃伊。

en.s: Hurricane Dorian was an extremely powerful and catastrophic tropical cyclone, which became the most intense on record to strike the Bahamas.
